answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 16 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in basalt, verified in summit, and shale names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, so that paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. The attacker spends 135 dollars and 5 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
